name: dispatch_ten_state_field_calls
description: Calls one argument-less unnamed routine, then ten unnamed routines each passed a longword read from a fixed offset in the game-state block, then another argument-less call. The callees are not identified, so their individual effects are unknown.

name: advance_state_machine_tick
description: In state 2 with a positive counter it moves ten units from that counter into a stored value and clears the timer. Otherwise it selects one of two status codes by comparing an object field with a table entry, sets a countdown of 10, and advances the state through the default path.

name: choose_status_code_and_count
description: Sets the countdown to 10 and chooses status code 42 or 43 by comparing an object field with a table entry. In state 3 with a zero object field it counts up to seven, then switches to countdown 11 and the opposite code; in other states it clears a pending value, calls an unnamed routine and sets a flag.

name: tick_state3_status_counter
description: Sets a countdown of 10. In state 3 with a zero object field it increments a counter up to seven and then selects a final status code; in any other state it clears a pending value, calls an unnamed routine and sets a completion flag.

name: set_status_code_eleven
description: Sets a countdown of 11 and calls one of two unnamed routines depending on whether a field of the argument object is zero.

name: forward_single_unnamed_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns. It has no other effect.

name: clear_state_counter_and_flag
description: Clears a state-dependent counter, one field when the state is 1 and another otherwise, calls an unnamed routine, and sets a completion flag to 1.

name: clear_pending_value_and_flag
description: Clears a stored value, calls an unnamed routine, and sets a completion flag to 1.

name: run_frame_display_update
description: Updates several object pointers, waits until an unnamed routine reports success, then calls library functions at offsets -270, -252 and -150 to set up two regions sized 320 by 200 and the display. Advances a frame counter that wraps after eight, sets a status code of 8 and clears a stored timestamp.

name: resolve_round_end_countdown
description: Calls two unnamed routines for each of two objects, then in state 2 either sets result code 9 and ends the phase when the countdown reaches zero, or copies two object fields into stored values and reloads the countdown to 450.

name: process_object_proximity_events
description: Compares the position fields of two objects, and when the first is at or above the second it runs a fixed sequence of unnamed display and object calls, adds 10000 to a stored counter and sets a timer to 50. When an object type byte is absent from a zero-terminated list, it runs a second call sequence and sets the same timer.

name: run_object_event_sequence
description: If a counter field of the caller's object is zero it calls one unnamed routine. Otherwise it runs a fixed sequence of calls on four object pointers and two objects, sets result code 13, reloads a timer to 50 and copies a stored value.

name: invoke_unnamed_object_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine with an object pointer taken from the game-state block and returns.

name: allocate_linked_object_nodes
description: Allocates an object record through a library call at offset -396. Unless the caller's type is 5, it allocates and links two more records, copies position and size fields from the caller's data, and returns the record or zero when any allocation fails.

name: build_positioned_object_record
description: Allocates three linked records, sets fixed values 200 and 316 and type 4 in the first, and calls library function at offset -120. Stores the record in the caller's structure and returns one on success, zero otherwise.

name: verify_bitmap_row_transfer
description: Opens a resource through an unnamed routine, transfers each row listed in a table and checks that each transferred length equals width times height. It then makes a final transfer checked against 64 and returns one only when every check passes.

name: check_transfer_length_match
description: Opens a handle through an unnamed routine and performs one transfer of the requested length. It releases the handle and returns one when the transferred count equals the requested count, and zero otherwise or when opening fails.

name: run_transfer_and_compare_length
description: Runs one transfer using three values from the caller's frame, stores the result there, releases the handle, and returns whether the result equals the expected length.

name: release_handle_return_one
description: Calls library function at offset -36 on the handle from the caller's frame and returns one.

name: read_blocks_to_offset_buffer
description: Opens a handle and reads 512-byte blocks into the caller's buffer at increasing offsets until a read returns zero, then releases the handle and returns the total count. Returns zero when opening fails.

name: read_blocks_until_exhausted
description: Opens a handle and reads 512-byte blocks into a local stack buffer until a read returns nothing, then releases the handle and returns the total byte count. Returns zero when opening fails.

name: read_matching_length_header
description: Opens a handle and reads a 350-byte header into a local buffer. Returns the stored value only when the read count and the second header word both equal 350, otherwise returns zero, and releases the handle in every case.

name: create_timed_object_pair
description: Allocates an object record and its sub-record, sets default values of 127 and 1, and calls library function at offset -444 with the caller's value. Returns the record, or zero when an allocation or setup step fails.

name: advance_round_robin_slot
description: Advances a round-robin index in the caller's table, wrapping to zero at the table length. If the slot at the new index is set it returns the result of an unnamed routine applied to it, otherwise it returns the scaled index.

name: queue_indexed_object_entry
description: Sets an object record from a table entry indexed by the caller's count, using type 3, flag 17 and values from two tables. It releases any previously active entry, stores the new index, and returns the result of an unnamed routine.

name: deactivate_indexed_entry
description: If the record is marked active, it calls an unnamed routine on its handle. When that returns zero it sets the record's type to 11 and a flag, calls two routines, then clears the active flag and index.

name: store_entry_byte_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine on the record and, on success, stores the given byte in one flag field and clears the adjacent flag field.

name: initialize_record_flag_bytes
description: Calls an unnamed routine on the record and, on success, stores the given byte in one field, clears six following flag bytes and returns zero.

name: set_object_coordinates_and_refresh
description: Sets the object's two coordinate fields and marks it active. When the object was not already active it calls library functions at offsets -408, -420 and -426 for type 5 or -96 otherwise, then calls two unnamed routines and returns the result of a final one.

name: remove_object_from_list
description: Releases an object: for type 5 with a valid handle it calls library function at offset -414, otherwise it sets bit 1024 in a flag word and calls an unnamed routine. It clears the record's state field in both cases.

name: match_entry_against_table
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a table entry indexed by the caller's index, and when that succeeds calls another unnamed routine on the first field and returns one if it equals the stored value, otherwise zero.

name: relink_active_objects_in_order
description: Links the active entries of a seventeen-slot table into forward and reverse chains by comparing their key values with an unnamed routine. Returns the index found last.

name: link_three_objects_in_cycle
description: If three object pointers are set and a third check passes, it links the three objects into a cycle through their link fields and returns the check result. Otherwise it calls an unnamed fallback routine.

name: link_three_slots_into_cycle
description: If three slot pointers are set and a third check passes, it links the three objects into a cycle through their link fields and returns the check result. Otherwise it calls an unnamed fallback routine and returns its result.

name: dispatch_handler_by_record_code
description: Calls library function at offset -372 to get a record, and if it is set searches a four-entry table keyed by the record's code and calls the matching unnamed handler. When no entry matches it calls an unnamed routine with the record.

name: decrement_counter_then_forward
description: Decrements a stored counter when it is positive and the mode equals one, then calls an unnamed routine with a value from the caller's frame.

name: set_flag_and_forward_call
description: Sets a flag word to 1 and calls an unnamed routine with a value from the caller's frame.

name: set_flag_then_library_forward
description: Sets the same flag word to 1 and calls an unnamed routine, which in turn calls library function at offset -378 for the value in the caller's frame.

name: dispatch_command_code_switch
description: Dispatches a command code below 128. Code 80 resets a mode with type 3, state 5 and zeroed counters; code 81 sets type 2, state 5 and a countdown of 450; code 82 toggles between two states; code 85 calls an unnamed routine; code 89 sets type 1 and calls an unnamed routine; the rest are no-ops.

name: set_sprite_frames_by_state
description: Sets frame indices on two sprite records according to the state value, which is 1, 2 or 3, then calls an unnamed routine with fixed values 108 and 199 and a state-dependent pointer.

name: refresh_grid_cells_when_flagged
description: When its refresh flag is set, loops over a 32 by 15 grid, reads a value per cell from a table, combines it with two unnamed routine results and a library function at offset -582 masked to the low four bits, and passes each cell to an unnamed routine. It then clears the refresh flag.

name: fill_grid_cells_set_flag
description: Loops over a 32 by 15 grid, computes each cell value from a library function at offset -582 and two unnamed routine results, decrements nonzero components, and passes each cell to an unnamed routine. It then sets the refresh flag to 2.

name: update_sprite_pair_and_redraw
description: When an unnamed routine succeeds, it updates the position fields of two sprite records and toggles a flag, calls library functions at offsets -270, -192, -378, -390 and -150, redraws six entries in a loop, then clears a stored value and calls an unnamed routine with 300.

name: read_up_to_three_characters
description: Reads up to three character codes from an unnamed input routine into a buffer, stopping early at code 13 and cycling a value from 1 to 15 between reads. Each accepted character is passed to an unnamed routine with a position.

name: initialize_seven_slot_records
description: Fills seven record slots with a base pointer, a value from a table and a code byte from a table, resets a stored value to zero, and calls an unnamed routine with zero.

name: sort_and_pick_active_slot
description: Clears the status byte of six slots, stores the given value in the head record, bubble-sorts the six slots by their key field, and passes the first slot with nonzero status to an unnamed routine. It copies that slot's byte into a stored location and returns its pointer, or zero when no slot is active.

name: fill_buffer_with_spaces
description: Writes the value 32, the space character, into the given number of bytes starting at the buffer.

name: render_slot_text_fields
description: Renders one slot by calling three unnamed routines: the first with the slot's pointer and a width of 3, the second with the slot's first field into a five-byte buffer, and the third with that buffer, length 5 and the slot's code byte.

name: swap_redraw_frame_pointers
description: Exchanges two saved pointers with new values, calls library functions at offsets -378, -390 and -60, then calls an unnamed routine with bounds 250 and 70 and a flag of 32768. On failure it sets result code 4 and a flag, otherwise it repeats a routine call, and it restores the saved pointers in both cases.

name: redraw_panel_and_restore_pointers
description: Exchanges two saved pointers, calls library functions at offsets -378, -390 and -60, then calls an unnamed routine with bounds 250 and 100 and another unnamed routine. It restores the saved pointers at the end.

name: read_printable_key_event
description: Fetches an input event from an unnamed routine. When its type is the key-event type it keeps the code only if it is printable (32 to 127) or the return code 13, otherwise it returns zero, and it releases the event in every case.

name: update_record_by_type_switch
description: Dispatches on a record type from 1 to 6. Type 1 draws twelve tiles at computed positions and sets the horizontal extent, types 2 and 6 set a horizontal coordinate, types 3 and 4 set a pointer and refresh the record, and type 5 does nothing; a mode field is then copied into the record.

name: draw_twelve_tile_strip
description: Draws twelve tiles by calling an unnamed routine for each index, using a stored position pair offset by a constant and an index-scaled tile value. It then sets the record's horizontal extent and copies the mode field.

name: copy_record_header_fields
description: Copies two 16-bit values from the caller's record header into the record it points to, one into the field at offset 24 and one into the field at offset 22.

name: update_record_animation_frame
description: If a flag field of the record is set, it computes a frame pointer from an unnamed routine result, sets the record's size field to a scaled value and calls library function at offset -126. It then copies the header's 16-bit value into the record's state field.

name: update_frame_and_check_change
description: If the record's flag is set, it computes a frame pointer from an unnamed routine result, copies a record field into the size field, and calls an unnamed routine. When that succeeds and two type bytes differ it calls library function at offset -126, then copies the header value into the state field.

name: copy_header_state_field
description: Copies a 16-bit value from the record's header into its state field. Only this copy is visible in the decompiled body, so any wider role is not recovered.

name: update_record_frame_scaled
description: If the record's flag is set, it computes a frame pointer from an unnamed routine result, sets the size field to a scaled value and calls library function at offset -126. It then copies the header value into the state field.

name: test_object_flag_bit_1024
description: Returns one when bit 1024 is set in the flags word of the object pointed to by the argument, otherwise zero.

name: check_coordinate_passed_by_direction
description: Compares the coordinate at offset 8 of two records. For a direction flag of zero it returns one when the first is to the right of the second, otherwise it returns one when the first is to the left of the second.

name: step_record_and_check_blocker
description: Tries to step a record toward a target: when its status bit 32 is clear and no pending flag is set, it calls an unnamed routine to move it. When the move reports zero and the record type is 18 against a target of type 8 or 9, it sets the pending flag and stores the given value; otherwise it copies the target's coordinate into the record.

name: finish_pending_step_marker
description: Decrements a pending counter and, when it reaches zero, calls an unnamed routine on two objects with the code 36 unless their type is already 36. It returns the updated status word.

name: is_slot_active
description: Returns one when the pointer is non-null and the record's active field is nonzero, otherwise zero.

name: run_script_bytecode_loop
description: Interprets a byte-coded animation script for one record. Codes 250 to 253 reset the offset, stop, advance, or stop after one step; code 254 moves the record by a table value and toggles a flag; code 255 places table-indexed images with unnamed routines; other codes are copied into the record's current frame byte.

name: enter_script_loop_at_top
description: Entry point into the byte-coded script interpreter that shares its opcode table and end-of-data checks, entered at the top of the loop.

name: enter_script_loop_after_stop
description: Alternate entry into the byte-coded script interpreter with the same opcode table, which resets the current offset before its loop.

name: enter_script_loop_from_jump
description: Alternate entry into the byte-coded script interpreter with the same opcode table, used when a script jump is taken.

name: enter_script_loop_at_wait
description: Alternate entry into the byte-coded script interpreter with the same opcode table, which leaves the loop when the wait flag is set.

name: enter_script_loop_at_step
description: Alternate entry into the byte-coded script interpreter with the same opcode table, which advances the record by one step before the loop.

name: enter_script_loop_with_redraw
description: Alternate entry into the byte-coded script interpreter with the same opcode table, which calls an unnamed routine to place each image before the loop.

name: dispatch_record_by_mode
description: Calls one of two unnamed routines on the record depending on whether its mode field equals 1.

name: advance_record_coordinate_clamped
description: Moves a record's coordinate at offset 8 by a per-direction step from a table, subtracting it when the mode is 1 and adding it otherwise. It then clamps the coordinate to global limits when the record type is not 32 or 41, the pending flag is zero and the status code is 1 or 12.

name: stub_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this routine. It calls three unnamed routines and is entered from several places, so its function is not recovered.

name: stub_undecompiled_single_call
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this one-instruction routine. Its only known behaviour is a single call to an unnamed routine.

name: stub_undecompiled_three_calls
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this routine. It has 67 instructions, is called from two places and calls three unnamed routines, so its behaviour is not recovered.

name: handle_table_matched_event
description: Looks up a code in a 12-byte per-slot table and, when it matches, plays the event. Kind 2 places three sprite objects at positions derived from the object's coordinate, kind 1 places one, then the active object is recorded, the state is set to 7 and two counters are cleared.

name: refresh_active_slot_pairs
description: Loops over the 17 object slots and, for each active slot, calls two unnamed routines on it. When the object type is 1 and the state is 1 or 7 it swaps the pair by calling an unnamed routine on them, then makes one final unnamed call.

name: resolve_pair_slot_interaction
description: For the two tracked slots, when a slot is not flagged with bit 32 and is active, it calls an unnamed routine with the slot and its partner. The call is skipped when the slot has bit 128 set unless its own byte also has bit 128 set.

name: remap_record_code_by_kind
description: For an active record, selects a frame table entry according to its kind: kind 2 uses one table, kinds 1 and 3 use a combined flag word, others use zero. It derives a 4-bit index from that and, when the record's current code differs from the looked-up value, calls an unnamed routine to update it.

name: lookup_indexed_tile_byte
description: Returns a byte looked up through two index tables keyed by the two byte arguments, then a third table keyed by a value from an unnamed routine.

name: compute_coordinate_distance
description: Returns the absolute difference between the 16-bit coordinates at offset 8 of two records.

name: clear_flagged_tracked_slots
description: For each of two tracked slots, if status bit 64 is set it calls an unnamed routine on the slot.

name: read_offset_table_byte
description: Returns a byte from a fixed table at an index computed by an unnamed routine plus a fixed base offset.

name: apply_matching_code_actions
description: Looks up a sequence for the record's code in a 128-byte-per-entry table. When the first result is below 4 it scans the sequence in steps of two and, for each pair whose code matches the other record, calls an unnamed routine with the paired value.

name: clear_port_register_top_bits
description: Calls two library functions at offsets -132 and -138 around a masked update that clears the top two bits of a fixed hardware byte register.

name: remap_byte_rows_via_table
description: Repeats 88 times: copies ten bytes from the argument buffer, mapping each through a 256-entry lookup table into a scratch area in reverse order, then copies the scratch area back over the buffer.

name: build_bit_reverse_table
description: Fills a 256-entry table so that each index holds the byte with its eight bits reversed.

name: build_bit_reverse_row_table
description: Fills a buffer from the caller's pointer with the bit-reversed values of consecutive input bytes, stopping when the byte index wraps to zero.

name: call_indirect_table_entry
description: Calls one function through a pointer read from a global variable at offset -348 and returns, with no other operations.

name: lookup_slot_or_error
description: Clears a field of the caller's state, then returns the slot address for an index inside the valid range when that slot is non-null. Otherwise it sets error code 9 and returns zero.

name: open_library_init_display
description: Opens the operating system library through the exec open-library call on first use and stores its base. It then copies a stored value into another field and calls two unnamed routines with fixed values 250, 40 and 20.

name: flush_dirty_records_list
description: Walks a linked list of records and, for each record with bit 2 set and bit 4 clear whose two counters differ, calls an unnamed routine with the difference. It then calls an unnamed routine with the given value.

name: lookup_slot_and_forward
description: Looks up a record by the first argument and returns minus one if none is found. Otherwise it forwards the record pointer with the other two arguments to an unnamed routine, returning minus one when a stored error flag is set.

name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends up to a caller-supplied limit of characters from the source string to the end of the destination string, terminates the result with a null byte, and returns the destination pointer.

name: forward_record_with_reset
description: Looks up a record by its first argument and returns minus one when it is missing. If the record's flag byte has bit 8 set it first calls an unnamed routine with zero and two, then forwards the record data with the other two arguments and returns minus one when an error flag is set.

name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Splits the command-line string into up to 32 arguments, treating spaces, tabs and newlines as separators and double-quoted text as one argument. With no arguments it uses a stored default block, then queries library functions and sets up two signal and handle entries.

name: run_init_and_main_loop
description: Allocates records and resources in order, opening libraries and checking each step, and exits early when a step fails. On success it sets up the display and runs a loop that dispatches on a status code until the code 4 is reached. The listing is truncated, so later steps are not fully recovered.

name: divide_32bit_with_sign_handling
description: Divides a 32-bit value by another 32-bit value. Negative operands are routed through unnamed routines and the result negated, while positive operands use normalised 16-bit partial divisions to return the quotient.

name: divide_32bit_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 32-bit divisor using normalised 16-bit partial divisions and returns the quotient and remainder packed into one 64-bit result.

name: multiply_32bit_words
description: Returns the low 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit values, built from the two cross products of their 16-bit halves shifted into the high word plus the low-word product.

name: release_unflagged_slots_then_forward
description: Loops over the slot table and, for each non-empty slot without bit 4 set, calls an unnamed routine on its second entry. It then calls an unnamed routine with the two parameters.

name: poll_break_signal_bits
description: Reads the task signal bits and tests bits 12 and 13. When either is set and a stored handler returns nonzero it calls an unnamed routine with 20, and it returns the masked signal bits or zero.

name: open_library_and_load_block
description: Opens the operating system library on first use, copies a stored value into another field, and calls an unnamed routine with buffers and the values 250 and 60. Returns zero on success and minus one otherwise.

name: check_io_status_record_error
description: Clears a stored status and calls library function at offset -48. When its result is minus one it also calls library function at offset -132 and stores error code 5, then returns the result.

name: seek_with_origin_mode
description: Calls library function at offset -66 to get the current position, storing error code 22 when it fails. It then returns the offset, the current position plus the offset, or the seek result, selected by the mode argument.

name: close_handle_and_return_zero
description: Clears a stored flag through an unnamed routine when it is set, calls library function at offset -36 to close the handle and returns zero.

name: next_random_scaled_value
description: Steps a 32-bit shift-register pseudo-random generator once per bit of the argument, reseeding it with a fixed feedback constant when the carry is set or the state is zero. It returns the low word of the state, or the scaled high word when the argument is nonzero.

name: init_self_linked_header
description: Writes the block's own address plus four into its first word, clears the second word and points the third word back at the block.

name: allocate_indexed_record_block
description: Obtains a slot index from an unnamed routine and, when valid, allocates a 34-byte block through a library call with flags 65537. It fills the block with the parameter, a flag byte, the constant 4 and the slot index, calls library functions, and returns the block or zero when a step fails.

name: release_record_chain
description: Recursively releases a linked chain of records, processing the linked record first when its link field is set. It then marks the record's type byte as 255, sets its long field to minus one, releases the indexed block and calls an unnamed routine with 34.

name: call_library_function_30
description: Calls the library function at offset -30 through the library base held in a global variable and returns, with no other operations.

name: call_library_function_198
description: Calls the library function at offset -198 through the library base held in a global variable and returns, with no other operations.

name: call_indirect_via_global_30
description: Calls a function pointer read from a global variable at offset -30 and returns, with no other operations.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing. Its entry is recorded by execution but it has no body to describe.

name: decode_backward_bitstream
description: Decodes a bit-packed stream by reading bits from a stored byte and copying run-length groups backwards from the input into the output buffer. It shares its bit-reader state with the caller's routine.
